div.div:
Dead values (grey, dashed): UNVERIFIED,
NOT_SUBMITTED and EXPIRED are allowed by the DB
CHECK constraint but no code writes them on this
table. Retention cleanup removes files only;
it does not set EXPIRED.

Rows are created directly as PENDING
(or VERIFIED by email domain match).
Resubmission after NEEDS_MORE_INFORMATION
creates a NEW row (revision+1,
previousRequestId) in PENDING.
